articles.summary: We've partnered with Tailscale (the best VPN service for secure networks) and Helicone, a YC company and AI gateway for various LLMs. We've also improved the Cost Optimization feature for users with reserved instances on AWS, and made some ease-of-use improvements to Environment Groups and alerts for applications.
articles.title: Tailscale Integration, Cost Optimization Granularity, Helicone Add-on, and Improved App Alerts
